description: The most important festival celebrated with special Abhishekam, pujas and night-long prayers.
A holy month during which devotees perform Deepa Aradhana and special Shiva worship.
Telugu New Year celebrated with special prayers.

The historic temple grounds serve as a major central hub for the state festival of Bathukamma. Thousands of local women gather in traditional attire around the temple steps to arrange floral stacks and offer prayers.
importance: The most prominent socio-cultural festival celebrated at the temple site.

description: Organized by the tourism department to showcase the architectural marvels of the Kakatiya dynasty. Features grand classical dance performances (such as Perini Sivatandavam) illuminated against the thousand pillars.
importance: Official heritage and tourism festival celebrating the temple's architectural lineage.
